QuestInfo.name: [Vampire Season] Blood Cure
QuestInfo.0: A wandering doctor in shabby clothes has grabbed you to talk.
QuestInfo.1: The doctor specializes in viruses, and is in fact the twin brother of the once-human Dark King. He's been working to stop the spread of the infection that claimed his brother, and has created a cure, the Blood Cure.
QuestInfo.2: You received the Blood Cure from Dr. Cherry.
